description: YouTube thumbnail 1280 × 720 PNG (grey): a frame of the footage in black and white, the white chevron at the left edge and a 2–5-word headline in Neuborn capitals, right-aligned. With candidates: 2–4 proposals as a 2 × 2 contact sheet for the editor's choice. A still image next to the video – never on the timeline; the editor approves it in the thumbnail review.

parameters.headline: 2–5 words, drawn in capitals; explicit line breaks with \n, otherwise spread over up to 3 balanced lines
parameters.frame: The frame the editor chose { sourceId | extensionId, in, crop? } (in = source seconds, crop like a timeline clip; without crop the picture covers the frame)
parameters.candidates: Instead of frame: 2–4 proposed frames (same shape) rendered as a labelled contact sheet A–D
